answer: SUCCESS:RES-0132. On three historical lockfiles chosen because a later advisory landed inside 30 days of a then-green pin, the T+30 verdict flip rate is 3/3=1.0 and the T+0→T+7 plus T+7→T+30 interval flip rate is 0.5. Median lag from advisory published to the first checkpoint that names it is 7.9424 days (n=4 named flips: GHSA-h75v-3vvj-5mfj@T+7d lag=1.402d, GHSA-9wx4-h78v-vm56@T+30d lag=10.156d, GHSA-grv7-fg5c-xmjg@T+30d lag=16.229d, GHSA-3xgq-45jj-v275@T+30d lag=5.729d). The in-tree product frozen lockfile (historical-role product-frozen-green, @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.29.0) did NOT flip GREEN→RED between 2026-07-25 and 2026-08-24. Control pins lodash@4.17.11 and requests==2.25.1 are RED at T+0, so the harness can see a positive. GitHub Advisory REST published_at UTC date agrees with OSV published for every named GHSA in the second-signal set. This is a dated-cut over a live 2026-08-24 OSV querybatch (osv-scanner/pip-audit binaries are not installed; both wrap OSV). Historical flip rate is not a random-lockfile probability.
